title: Sage 2D scalar and vector fields
objective: Implement deterministic shared rectangular-grid sampling, semantic PlotSpec layers, Plotly lowering payloads, and qualified Sage wrappers for contour, density, implicit, region, vector, and slope-field plots with explicit option outcomes and bounded resources

oracles: CPython versus Sage.js native-disabled differential tests

validation: pnpm exec pyright src/lib/sagejs/plotting/grid_sampling.py src/lib/sagejs/plotting/field_layers.py src/lib/sage/plot/contour_plot.py src/lib/sage/plot/density_plot.py src/lib/sage/plot/plot_field.py

runs.command: pnpm exec pyright src/lib/sagejs/plotting/grid_sampling.py src/lib/sagejs/plotting/field_layers.py src/lib/sage/plot/contour_plot.py src/lib/sage/plot/density_plot.py src/lib/sage/plot/plot_field.py
pnpm exec pyright src/lib/sagejs/plotting/grid_sampling.py src/lib/sagejs/plotting/field_layers.py src/lib/sage/plot/contour_plot.py src/lib/sage/plot/density_plot.py src/lib/sage/plot/plot_field.py

handoff.summary: Implemented a bounded shared rectangular-grid planner and scalar/vector samplers, deterministic contour levels, finite masks and diagnostics, resource limits, six semantic PlotSpec layer kinds, direct Plotly payload lowering, qualified Sage constructors and primitive holders, pinned Sage 10.9.post1 oracle fixtures, focused native-disabled differential tests, documentation, and a checksum-validating performance benchmark. Fast finite bulk sampling reduced the measured 160,000-point scalar case from roughly 2.1-3.0 seconds during development to about 0.45-0.63 seconds in Sage.js, and the 10,000-point vector case from roughly 0.29-0.37 seconds to about 0.12-0.15 seconds.
risks: The qualified Sage constructors deliberately return PlotSpec until the integration lane adds the common Graphics bridge; public Sage import coverage is therefore not claimed by this lane alone.
Symbolic-expression conversion is explicitly unsupported pending the central expression-to-callable bridge; callable fields are fully represented and unknown options never pass silently.
A bulk callable that raises is reevaluated pointwise to produce precise masks and reason counts, so field callables are expected to be pure.

The full integration suite failed on this base with 35 unrelated native artifact, FFI metadata, multiprocessing, timing, and optional-capability failures. The only plotting-named failure is a pre-existing deterministic inventory hash mismatch for test/graphics.cjs; this lane does not modify that file or inventory.

Architecture checking intentionally reports the three new sage.plot wrappers as unclassified until the integration lane adds their exact paths to the plot-spec package. The current plot-spec size budget has approximately 21 KiB remaining after that classification.
next_steps: Add the two sagejs.plotting modules and three sage.plot wrappers to pyrightconfig.json.
Classify src/lib/sage/plot/contour_plot.py, density_plot.py, and plot_field.py as exact plot-spec files in architecture/package-graph.json.
Export the desired helpers and qualified constructors from the two central __init__.py files.
Teach sagejs.plotting.lowering.lower_layer to dispatch FIELD_LAYER_KINDS to lower_field_layer before generic semantic 2D lowering.
Bridge returned PlotSpecs through the common Graphics constructor while preserving layers, diagnostics, provenance, axes intent, and resource diagnostics.
Register test/sage-2d-fields.cjs in test/node-test-manifest.cjs, then update coverage ledgers only after the public Graphics bridge is exercised.
